roadmap.title: Tutorial and first week
roadmap.description: Bury your first body, extract your first meat, meet the Bishop, repair the bridge and garden and start the cellar questlines.

roadmap.title: Meet the village and clear early dungeon floors
roadmap.description: Meet every main NPC, unlock the church upgrade, clear dungeon floors 5 and 10 and begin the NPC questlines.

roadmap.title: Finish the base-game questlines
roadmap.description: Finish the Snake, Inquisitor, Merchant, Charm and Astrologer questlines, upgrade the church again, and open the portal.

roadmap.title: Stranger Sins DLC
roadmap.description: Buy land, build and grow the tavern, hold events and watch the time-machine scenes.

roadmap.title: Game Of Crone DLC
roadmap.description: Solve the vampire mystery, upgrade the refugee camp, finish the revolution and refugee questlines and choose an ending.

roadmap.title: Better Save Soul DLC
roadmap.description: Repair Euric's room, complete the three curing sessions and help the villagers.

achievements.description: Buried your first body.
achievements.summary: Bury your first body in the graveyard.

steps.text: Bury the body you are given in the tutorial.

achievements.description: Buried 10 bodies.
achievements.summary: Bury 10 bodies in the graveyard; cremations do not count.

steps.text: Bury the bodies that arrive as you play until 10 are buried.
steps.note: Burning a body does not count as a burial.

achievements.description: Buried 50 bodies.
achievements.summary: Bury 50 bodies in the graveyard; cremations do not count.

steps.text: Bury bodies as you play until 50 are buried.
steps.note: Bury different bodies to be safe. Burning does not count.

achievements.description: Got your first slice of meat. Smells a little strange, but looks like ordinary meat...
achievements.summary: Remove Flesh from a corpse during the autopsy in the tutorial.

steps.text: Follow the tutorial autopsy and remove the Flesh from the corpse.

achievements.description: Made 30 slices. You've got the perfect size slice pretty much down.
achievements.summary: Remove Flesh from corpses 30 times.

guide.context: The achievement counts extractions, so you do not need to slice the meat.

steps.text: Do an autopsy on corpses and take out the Flesh each time.
steps.note: Keep the Meat for Burgers later.

achievements.description: Upgraded the church.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the church for the first time by giving the Bishop the Building permission.

guide.context: After the upgrade you can only preach in the church if you own the Rightful citizen papers.

steps.text: Give the @npc{Bishop} 20 @item{Ceramic bowls}.
Raise the graveyard rating to 30 and the church rating to 20.
Bring the Bishop 4 @item{Quality fish fillet}.
Buy a @item{Building permission} at the Royal services box and give it to the Bishop.

achievements.description: Upgraded the church for the second time.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the church for the second time, turning it into a Cathedral.

steps.text: Raise the graveyard rating to 200 and the church rating to 50.
Carve 3 @item{Carved piece of marble} in gold quality.
Give them to the @npc{Bishop}.
steps.note: An Iron chisel at gold quality, or at silver quality with technology boosts, is needed for gold marble.

achievements.description: Caught 6 different types of fish. One fish for every day!
achievements.summary: Catch 6 different types of fish.

guide.context: A fish found at several spots counts only once.

steps.text: Meet the @npc{Lighthouse Keeper} and get a fishing rod.
Fish at different fishing spots until you have caught 6 types of fish.

achievements.description: Caught 10 different types of fish.
achievements.summary: Catch 10 different types of fish.

guide.context: A fish found at several spots counts only once.

steps.text: Keep fishing at every fishing spot, with an upgraded rod, until you have caught 10 types of fish.

achievements.description: Caught 15 types of fish! You know everything about fish. They feel uncomfortable about it...
achievements.summary: Catch 15 different types of fish.

guide.context: A fish found at several spots counts only once.

steps.text: Fish at every spot with an upgraded rod until you have caught 15 types of fish.

achievements.description: Caught 200 fish. Your name is used to terrify misbehaving fish larvae.
achievements.summary: Catch 200 fish in total.

steps.text: Keep fishing until your total reaches 200.
steps.note: Casting at the nearest range with no bait works well.

achievements.description: Got a gold fish. Want to make a wish?
achievements.summary: Catch a Goldfish at the Sea fishing spot.

guide.context: It needs luck: the chance is 5% at night and 2% during the day.

steps.text: Buy an @item{Excellent fishing rod} and a @item{Lure with a gem} from the @npc{Lighthouse Keeper} once he reaches tier III.
Fish at the Sea spot at night and cast at the furthest range.
Keep casting until a Goldfish bites.
steps.note: Bring extra lures.

achievements.description: Cooked 10 different dishes or drinks.
achievements.summary: Cook 10 different dishes or drinks.

guide.context: Each dish counts once, so cook different recipes.

steps.text: Cook a new recipe each time until you have made 10 different dishes or drinks.
steps.note: Buy extra recipes from @npc{Miss Chain} if you run out.

achievements.description: Cooked 20 different dishes or drinks.
achievements.summary: Cook 20 different dishes or drinks.

guide.context: Each dish counts once, so cook different recipes.

steps.text: Cook new recipes until you have made 20 different dishes or drinks.
steps.note: Buy extra recipes from @npc{Miss Chain} if you run out.

achievements.description: Cooked 30 different dishes or drinks. You can call yourself a Chef now.
achievements.summary: Cook 30 different dishes or drinks.

guide.context: Each dish counts once, so cook different recipes.

steps.text: Unlock recipes through technologies, quests, and purchases from @npc{Miss Chain}.
Cook new recipes until you have made 30 different dishes or drinks.

achievements.description: Made a gold-star dinner.
achievements.summary: Cook a gold-star Dinner.

guide.context: Quality is random. Save before cooking and reload if the Dinner is not gold-star.

steps.text: Unlock the Cake recipe by finishing @npc{Dig}'s quest to bring 5 Honey.
Buy gold-star @item{Onion rings} from @npc{Horadric} once he reaches tier III.
Cook a @item{Dinner} from the Onion rings, a Burger, and a Cake.

achievements.description: Ate a fish stick. It reminded you of home...
achievements.summary: Eat one Fish nugget (the fish stick).

steps.text: Buy a @item{Fish nuggets} from @npc{Horadric} at @loc{The Dead Horse}.
Eat it.

achievements.description: Discovered 5 alchemy recipes. You're getting to know how things work in the lab.
achievements.summary: Discover 5 alchemy recipes.

guide.context: Alternate recipes for the same product do not count.

steps.text: Combine ingredients at the @mechanic{Alchemy workbench} until you have discovered 5 recipes.

achievements.description: Discovered 10 alchemy recipes. Just remember, the Philosopher's Stone is a lie.
achievements.summary: Discover 10 alchemy recipes.

guide.context: Alternate recipes for the same product do not count.

steps.text: Keep combining ingredients at the @mechanic{Alchemy workbench} until you have discovered 10 recipes.

achievements.description: Discovered 20 alchemy recipes. Now it's time to buy a white van and drive into the desert.
achievements.summary: Discover 20 alchemy recipes.

guide.context: Alternate recipes for the same product do not count. Tier II recipes are needed to reach 20.

steps.text: Upgrade to the tier II @mechanic{Alchemy workbench}.
Keep combining ingredients until you have discovered 20 recipes.

achievements.description: 50 health potions. -- And all of them red!
achievements.summary: Drink 50 Heal potions.

guide.context: Potions you craft, buy, or find all count.

steps.text: Drink @item{Heal potion} whenever you need health until you have drunk 50.

achievements.description: There can be only one.
achievements.summary: Die 10 times.

steps.text: Let enemies kill you in the @loc{Dungeon}, or walk the path past the @loc{Apiary} without armor in the evening.
Repeat until you have died 10 times.

achievements.description: Dungeon level 5 cleared!
achievements.summary: Clear floor 5 of the Dungeon.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Dungeon} through Snake's questline and clear floor 5.
Open the chest at the end of floor 5.
steps.note: Monsters you kill stay dead, so you can clear a floor over several trips.

achievements.description: Dungeon level 10 cleared!
achievements.summary: Clear floor 10 of the Dungeon.

steps.text: At night, find @npc{Koukol} and buy his @item{Damask sword with a gem}.
steps.note: He is next to the Mountain Fort. Most enemies die in one hit.

steps.text: Go deeper into the @loc{Dungeon} and clear floor 10.

achievements.description: Dungeon level 15 cleared!
achievements.summary: Clear floor 15 of the Dungeon.

guide.context: Floors 11 to 15 stay closed until you get the medallion from the Vampire hunter in Snake's questline.

steps.text: Finish the @npc{Snake} quests that give the medallion for floors 11 to 15.
Clear floors 11 to 15 of the @loc{Dungeon}.

achievements.description: Harvested a gold-star pumpkin.
achievements.summary: Harvest a gold-star Pumpkin.

steps.text: Buy @item{Pumpkin seeds} from the @npc{Farmer}, or gold ones at tier III.
Use @item{Quality fertilizer} on the seeds to raise their quality.
Plant the seeds and harvest a gold-star Pumpkin.

achievements.description: Made a gold-star wine.
achievements.summary: Make a gold-star Red wine.

guide.context: Without the wine quality perk there is a 50% chance it comes out silver, so save before fermenting.

steps.text: Grow 30 gold-star @item{Grapes} at the @loc{Vineyard}, using better seeds or @item{Quality fertilizer}.
Turn them into 2 gold-star @item{Pail of grape juice}.
Ferment the juice in the @mechanic{Wine barrel}.

achievements.description: Met Astrologer. He's wise and tired of everything, even life.
achievements.summary: Talk to the Astrologer at the Lighthouse for the first time.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Lighthouse} in the far east on Sloth day and talk to the @npc{Astrologer}.
steps.note: A @item{Teleportstone} from @loc{The Dead Horse} tavern saves a long walk.

achievements.description: Met Ms Charm. There's something about this woman that you can't understand.
achievements.summary: Talk to Ms. Charm for the first time.

steps.text: Go to @loc{The Dead Horse} tavern on Lust day and talk to @npc{Ms. Charm} while she performs.

achievements.description: Met Merchant. He's always ready to do business. Except around dinner time.
achievements.summary: Talk to the Merchant for the first time.

steps.text: Go to the spot just south of @loc{The Dead Horse} tavern on Gluttony day and talk to the @npc{Merchant}.

achievements.description: Met the Lord Inquisitor. An unwavering kind of guy. You definitely wouldn't want to be his enemy.
achievements.summary: Talk to the Inquisitor on Witch Hill for the first time.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Witch Hill} on Wrath day and talk to the @npc{Inquisitor}.

achievements.description: Met Bishop. His motto - Pray, preach, and look like you won the lottery.
achievements.summary: Talk to the Bishop for the first time.

steps.text: Bury your first body, then talk to the @npc{Bishop} when he appears.
steps.note: Later he stands near the @loc{Church} on Pride day.

achievements.description: Snake summoned a chicken. Well... it's a start. Better than nothing.
achievements.summary: Give Snake 5 Bloody nails and a Bucket of blood so his ritual summons a chicken.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Iron Maiden}s in the Dungeon until you have 5 @item{Bloody nails}.
Clear Dungeon level 5 and open its chest to get the @item{Bucket of blood}.
steps.note: You can craft one at the @mechanic{Church workbench} from 10 @item{Blood} and 3 @item{Flitch}. If your bag is full, free a slot to pick it up.

steps.text: Give both to @npc{Snake} and watch his ritual.

achievements.description: You killed a Vampire Hunter. In life, there are no side quests.
achievements.summary: Crush the Vampire hunter with the boulder during Snake's questline.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Snake} on Witch Hill, just below the Vineyard, with 1 @item{Wooden plank}.
Push the boulder onto the hunter.
Mine the boulder afterwards to get the medallion.

achievements.description: Decorated a Dark Shrine. Looks better than your first apartment!
achievements.summary: Decorate the Dark Shrine to a Pentagram rating of 20 with the Dark design desk.

guide.context: Every decoration is required.

steps.text: Collect 10 @item{Polishing paste}, 24 @item{Skull}, 2 @item{Stone repair kit}, 8 @item{Wooden beam}, 10 @item{A polished brick of stone}, and 4 silver-star @item{Pumpkin}.
Use the @mechanic{Dark design desk} to place every decoration at the Dark Shrine.
Fill both blood fountains with 20 @item{Blood}.

achievements.description: Sold burgers at the burning ceremony. It's a mystery why you didn't make hotdogs.
achievements.summary: Serve 5 Burgers and 10 Beers at the Witch Hill buffet during the burning ceremony.

steps.text: Build the @mechanic{Buffet tent} at @loc{Witch Hill}: 5 @item{Hemp rope}, 15 @item{Wooden plank} and 20 @item{Nails}.
Buy @item{Onion seeds} from the @npc{Farmer} and @item{Hops seeds} from the @npc{Miller}. Grow them with @item{Quality fertilizer}.
steps.note: @item{Hops} only grow at the @loc{Vineyard}, west of @loc{Witch Hill}.

steps.text: Cook 5 @item{Burgers} and 10 @item{Beers}.
On Wrath day, open the buffet at @loc{Witch Hill} and serve them.

achievements.description: Collected three dark organs. Three in a row! The Inquisition is going to get a prize!
achievements.summary: Give the Inquisitor a Dark heart, a Dark intestine, and a Dark brain.

steps.text: Take on the @npc{Inquisitor}'s request for dark organs.
Do autopsies on corpses until you have a @item{Dark heart}, a @item{Dark intestine}, and a @item{Dark brain}.
Give all three to the Inquisitor.

achievements.description: Got rid of the guardsmen's ambush. Now you are the Witch Hill Keeper too!
achievements.summary: Clear the guardsmen's ambush during the Inquisitor's questline.

steps.text: Return 3 @item{Dark organs} to the @npc{Inquisitor}, then continue his questline until you clear the guardsmen's ambush.

achievements.description: Gave some perfume to Ms Charm. It smells nice, and wasn't tested on animals.
achievements.summary: Give the perfume from Miss Chain to Ms. Charm.

steps.text: Ask @npc{Miss Chain} for the perfume. She wants a @item{Basket of food} taken to @npc{Clotho} in the @loc{Swamp}.
Bring Miss Chain 12 @item{Frogs}.
steps.note: @npc{Clotho} sells up to 10. Fish the rest at the swamp fishing spot with @item{Moth} as bait.

steps.text: Give the @item{Perfume} to @npc{Ms. Charm}.

achievements.description: Got an Ideal Song from Vagner. Now you know how you'll make a million bucks, once you get back home.
achievements.summary: Get the Ideal Song from Vagner during Ms. Charm's questline.

steps.text: Give @npc{Vagner} an @item{Infusion}, made by distilling 1 @item{Booze} and 3 @item{Red mushroom}.
The next day, read his note. After dark, walk to the cliffs north of the beach to see the cutscene.
Give the song to @npc{Ms. Charm}.

achievements.description: Started a company with Merchant. A great name for a successful company!
achievements.summary: Give the Merchant a Trade license to start a company with him.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{Royal services box} beside the @loc{Church} to buy the @item{Rightful citizen status} and the @item{Trade license}.
Give the @item{Trade license} to the @npc{Merchant} on Gluttony day.

achievements.description: Your company achieved 5 Fame. When you want quality vegetables -- you go to the graveyard!
achievements.summary: Raise your trade company's Fame to 5 by turning in 50 Flyers.

steps.text: Buy @item{Ink} from the @npc{Astrologer}. Do not buy @item{Pen and ink}.
At the @mechanic{Church workbench}, turn @item{Skin} or @item{Bat wing} into @item{Clean paper}.
Combine @item{Ink} and @item{Clean paper} at the @mechanic{Printing press} to make @item{Flyers}.
Hand in 50 @item{Flyers} at the table inside the @loc{Trade Office}.
steps.note: Every 10 Flyers gives 1 Fame.

achievements.description: Gave a gold-star book to Astrologer. You should consider writing six more...
achievements.summary: Give the Astrologer a gold-star Book.

guide.context: @warn{Never give him a Research Obsidian instead of a Book.} That skips the step and you can no longer earn this unlock.

steps.text: Make a @item{Book} by combining a @item{Chapter} with a @item{Hard cover} bought from the @npc{Astrologer}.
Give him the @item{Book} he asks for.
About a week later, bring him a gold-star @item{Book}.
steps.note: Save before crafting and reload until the @item{Book} comes out gold-star.

achievements.description: Fixed the garden. You'll spend a lot of time here...
achievements.summary: Fix the garden by turning in the Garden certificate at its blueprint desk.

steps.text: Interact with the broken blueprint desk in the garden to start the quest.
Talk to @npc{Horadric} to get the @item{Garden certificate}.
Use the certificate at the blueprint desk.

achievements.description: Built a stone fence around the graveyard. Your graveyard is well protected now.
achievements.summary: Finish the stone fence that surrounds the graveyard.

steps.text: Fix the old fence with 10 @item{Nails}, 10 @item{Wooden plank}, and 6 @item{Piece of stone}.
Then build the stone fence from 12 @item{Complex iron parts}, 2 @item{Carved piece of stone}, and 24 @item{Polished brick of stone}.

achievements.description: Got the marble quarry ready. Marble is better than stone.
achievements.summary: Build the regular Marble quarry, not the Zombie marble quarry.

steps.text: Repair the bridge and clear the blockage on the north road.
Build the regular @loc{Marble quarry}, not the Zombie one.

achievements.description: Gave a skull to Astrologer. A skull makes a nice present indeed!
achievements.summary: Give the Astrologer a Skull.

steps.text: Extract a @item{Skull} from a body.
Give the @item{Skull} to the @npc{Astrologer}.

achievements.description: Fixed the mill. No further need to grind everything by hand.
achievements.summary: Repair the mill north of the Farmer's house.

steps.text: Ask the @npc{Miller} for repair instructions.
Take the instructions to the @npc{Astrologer} (60 Happiness needed) to get the @item{Paper with calculations}.
Repair the mill with 5 @item{Complex iron parts}, 6 @item{Wooden plank}, and the paper.

achievements.description: Gave the Necronomicon to Snake. Hope nobody uses it as cookbook!
achievements.summary: Give the Necronomicon to Snake.

steps.text: Ask the @npc{Astrologer} about the book Snake wants. He sends you to the @npc{Lighthouse Keeper}.
Trade 5 @item{Maggots} to the @npc{Lighthouse Keeper} for the @item{Necronomicon}.
Give the @item{Necronomicon} to @npc{Snake}.

achievements.description: Fixed the bridge. Whatever else happens, you'll always be remembered as a great bridge builder!
achievements.summary: Repair the bridge on the road west of the graveyard.

steps.text: Go to the broken bridge west of the graveyard.
Collect the materials it asks for and repair it.

achievements.description: Collected 1000 green points. They do not decay at midnight. So that was easy.
achievements.summary: Collect 1000 green points.

steps.text: Earn green points by farming, gathering, and studying the materials involved.
Eat a cake or pie for the Circumspect effect before studying new items at the @mechanic{Study table}.

achievements.description: Collected 1000 blue points. They do not decay at midnight. So that was easy.
achievements.summary: Collect 1000 blue points.

steps.text: Earn blue points by writing stories, notes, chapters and books, crafting grave decorations and alchemy components, and studying related materials.
Craft @item{Stone grave fence}: it gives 5 blue points for 2 @item{Piece of stone}.
Eat a cake or pie for the Circumspect effect before studying new items at the @mechanic{Study table}.

achievements.description: Collected 1000 red points. They do not decay at midnight. So that was easy.
achievements.summary: Collect 1000 red points.

steps.text: Earn red points by forging, carpentry, and studying the tools and materials involved.
Eat a cake or pie for the Circumspect effect before studying new items at the @mechanic{Study table}.

achievements.description: Collected 3000 green points. Ok. Now that's impressive.
achievements.summary: Collect 3000 green points.

guide.context: Do not use a Techbook to pass 3000 points. The achievement may stop working.

steps.text: Keep earning green points by farming, gathering, and studying the materials involved.
Earn the last points by gathering, crafting, or studying, not with a @item{Techbook}.

achievements.description: Collected 3000 blue points. Ok. Now that's impressive.
achievements.summary: Collect 3000 blue points.

guide.context: Do not use a Techbook to pass 3000 points. The achievement may stop working.

steps.text: Keep earning blue points by writing stories, notes, chapters and books, crafting grave decorations and alchemy components, and studying related materials.
Craft @item{Stone grave fence} for 5 blue points each, then recycle it to get back 1 @item{Piece of stone}.
Earn the last points by gathering, crafting, or studying, not with a @item{Techbook}.

achievements.description: Collected 3000 red points. Ok. Now that's impressive.
achievements.summary: Collect 3000 red points.

guide.context: Do not use a Techbook to pass 3000 points. The achievement may stop working.

steps.text: Keep earning red points by forging, carpentry, and studying the tools and materials involved.
Earn the last points by gathering, crafting, or studying, not with a @item{Techbook}.

achievements.description: Switched on the portal.
achievements.summary: Craft the six portal parts at the Witch Hill portal to switch it on.

steps.text: Finish the @npc{Snake}, @npc{Merchant} and @npc{Astrologer} questlines to get all six parts.
Stand at the @mechanic{portal} on @loc{Witch Hill} and craft the six parts there.

achievements.description: Helped Astrologer reunite with his family.
achievements.summary: Start the excavation from the Astrologer's dialogue and watch the cutscene that reunites him with his family.

steps.text: A week after giving the @npc{Astrologer} the gold-star @item{Book}, talk to him and start the excavation.

achievements.description: Helped Merchant forgive his brother.
achievements.summary: Give the Bishop the Aristocrat papers and the Accepted invitation, then watch the cutscene that reconciles the Merchant with his brother.

steps.text: Finish the @npc{Merchant}'s questline up to his ceremony, then buy the @item{Aristocrat papers} at the @mechanic{Royal services box}.
On Pride day, give the @npc{Bishop} the @item{Aristocrat papers} and the @item{Accepted invitation}.
Talk to the @npc{Bishop} again to start the cutscene.

achievements.description: Helped Snake with his dark ceremony.
achievements.summary: Give Snake a Dark heart to finish his dark ritual.

steps.text: Give @npc{Snake} a @item{Dark heart} and watch his last ritual.

achievements.description: Betrayed Gerry. That's not something you should be super-proud of.
achievements.summary: Tell the Inquisitor about Gerry when he asks for more evidence.

guide.context: @warn{Choose the Gerry option first.} Picking another option first can block the Gerry option.

steps.text: Return 3 @item{Dark organs} to the @npc{Inquisitor}.
About a week later, talk to him when he asks for more evidence.
Pick the dialogue option about @npc{Gerry} first.

achievements.description: Met Snake. He seems dangerous. You get why everybody calls him Snake.
achievements.summary: Clear a blocked passage in the cellar and talk to Snake.

steps.text: Clear one of the two blocked passages in the @loc{Cellar} with 10 @item{Wood wedge}, 2 @item{Wooden plank} and 4 @item{Simple iron parts}.
Talk to @npc{Snake} at the gate on Envy day.
steps.note: Have 5 @item{Faith} with you, or he will not talk.

achievements.description: Bought your first land in the Village. By cheating a sick and helpless old man.
achievements.summary: Buy the first plot of land in the village from Horadric.

steps.text: Dig up the cognac mound north of @loc{Dig's barrel} for @npc{Gerry}.
Finish @npc{Horadric}'s errands, then buy the land he offers.

achievements.description: Built the tavern. Horadric wishes you were dead now.
achievements.summary: Have Cory build the tavern on your land and wake up after sleeping.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Cory}. Choose to give him materials (12 @item{Nails}, 12 @item{Wooden plank}, 12 @item{Simple iron parts} plus a payment) or to pay a larger sum instead.
Go to sleep. The tavern is built when you wake up.

achievements.description: Your tavern's quality is 20! Wow!
achievements.summary: Raise the tavern's quality to 20.

steps.text: Install the tavern upgrades that the time machine questline unlocks. Furniture upgrades give up to 59 of the 80 quality points.

achievements.description: Your tavern's quality is 40! Double Wow!
achievements.summary: Raise the tavern's quality to 40.

steps.text: Install the tavern upgrades that the time machine questline unlocks. Furniture upgrades give up to 59 of the 80 quality points.
Fill the Cabinet with Artifacts for the rest of the quality points.

achievements.description: Your tavern's quality is 80! Ultra Wow!
achievements.summary: Raise the tavern's quality to 80.

steps.text: Install tavern upgrades from the time machine questline and fill the @mechanic{Cabinet with Artifacts}.
steps.note: Furniture alone reaches only 59 quality.

achievements.description: Yorick became your bartender. For no salary. Slavery? No, he's made of wood!
achievements.summary: Bring the Barman doll to Yorick at the bar of the tavern.

steps.text: Make the @item{Barman doll} on @mechanic{Carpenter's workbench II} using 4 @item{Complex iron parts}, 4 @item{Wooden plank} and 2 @item{Wooden beam}.
Carry it behind the bar in @loc{The Talking Skull} and speak with @npc{Yorick}.

achievements.description: Threw your first alco-party. The guests remember nothing, but they enjoyed it.
achievements.summary: Organize your first Graveyard Fest at the tavern.

steps.text: Unlock Graveyard Fest through the time machine questline.
Start Graveyard Fest at the tavern. It costs 5 Flyers, 5 Faith and 1 Reputation.
steps.note: The Barman's inventory can stay empty.

achievements.description: Put on your first Comedy Show. The guests laughed on command, so everything went good.
achievements.summary: Organize your first Comedy Standup at the tavern.

steps.text: Unlock Comedy Standup through the time machine questline.
Start Comedy Standup at the tavern. It costs 10 Flyers, 5 Faith and 2 Reputation.
steps.note: The Barman's inventory can stay empty.

achievements.description: Put on your first concert. Ms. Charm's fans fell into ecstasy and a brawl broke out.
achievements.summary: Organize your first Ms Charm's Song at the tavern.

steps.text: Unlock Ms Charm's Song through the time machine questline.
Start Ms Charm's Song at the tavern. It costs 15 Flyers, 10 Faith and 3 Reputation.
steps.note: The Barman's inventory can stay empty.

achievements.description: Organized your first rat race. The winning rat got a giant piece of cheese, choked on it, and died.
achievements.summary: Organize your first Rat Races at the tavern.

steps.text: Unlock Rat Races through the time machine questline.
Start Rat Races at the tavern. It costs 10 Flyers, 5 Faith and 2 Reputation.
steps.note: The Barman's inventory can stay empty.

achievements.description: Threw an excellent alco-party. It's time to open the local drunk tank.
achievements.summary: Organize an excellent Graveyard Fest at the tavern.

steps.text: Put 100 Mug of beer and 100 Red wine in the Barman's own inventory, not the basement pallets.
Save the game, then start Graveyard Fest. Reload until the event is excellent.

achievements.description: Put on an excellent Comedy Show. It can't be -- the guests didn't have to be commanded to laugh!
achievements.summary: Organize an excellent Comedy Standup at the tavern.

steps.text: Put 100 Mug of beer and 60 Onion rings in the Barman's own inventory, not the basement pallets.
Save the game, then start Comedy Standup. Reload until the event is excellent.

achievements.description: Put on an excellent concert. Ms. Charm received a marriage proposal from each male spectator.
achievements.summary: Organize an excellent Ms Charm's Song at the tavern.

steps.text: Put 100 Red wine, 60 Burger and 40 Pasta in the Barman's own inventory, not the basement pallets.
Save the game, then start Ms Charm's Song. Reload until the event is excellent.

achievements.description: Organized an excellent rat race. Two guests lost everything and drowned themselves.
achievements.summary: Organize an excellent Rat Races at the tavern.

steps.text: Put 100 Mug of beer and 60 Onion rings in the Barman's own inventory, not the basement pallets.
Save the game, then start Rat Races. Reload until the event is excellent.

achievements.description: Organized 15 events. You're a natural-born event manager!
achievements.summary: Organize 15 events at the tavern.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Graveyard Fest} each time the Reputation bar fills until you have held 15 events.
steps.note: The Barman's inventory can stay empty.

achievements.description: Used the archaeological time machine for the first time. And didn't go mad.
achievements.summary: Feed the Statuette to the archaeological time machine and use it for the first time.

steps.text: Load the @item{Statuette}, the first Artifact, into the archaeological time machine.

achievements.description: Watched the Master being summoned.
achievements.summary: Watch the scene where the Master is summoned.

steps.text: Continue the Stranger Sins questline until the scene where the Master is summoned plays.

achievements.description: Watched the scene at the Coliseum.
achievements.summary: Watch the scene at the Coliseum.

steps.text: Continue the Stranger Sins questline until the scene at the Coliseum plays.

achievements.description: Watched the destruction of the Bridge.
achievements.summary: Watch the scene where the bridge is destroyed.

steps.text: Continue the Stranger Sins questline until the scene where the bridge is destroyed plays.

achievements.description: Witnessed the Contract signing.
achievements.summary: Watch the scene where the contract is signed.

steps.text: Continue the Stranger Sins questline until the contract signing scene plays.

achievements.description: Watched the scene in the bath house.
achievements.summary: Watch the scene in the bath house with Gerry as king.

steps.text: Continue the Stranger Sins questline until the scene in the bath house plays.

achievements.description: Met marquis Teodoro Jr. An aristocrat in danger - what could be more profitable!
achievements.summary: Meet Marquis Teodoro Jr. inside your Sweet Home.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Church}, then sleep until you wake up. @npc{Marquis Teodoro Jr.} appears in your @loc{Sweet Home}.

achievements.description: A vampire is terrorizing the villagers? Solution: an army of carnivorous bees.
achievements.summary: Let the villagers finish talking about the vampire danger at The Dead Horse tavern.

steps.text: Follow the vampire questline until the villagers gather at @loc{The Dead Horse} tavern. Wait for their talk to end.

achievements.description: Exposed the vampire. Time to play Van Helsing!
achievements.summary: Expose the vampire during the Vampires in the Village questline.

steps.text: Continue the Vampires in the Village questline until the vampire is exposed.

achievements.description: Alaric convinced you to help. Refusal would have been dangerous to your health.
achievements.summary: Speak to Master Alaric about stopping the ancient curse.

steps.text: After the vampire questline ends, talk to @npc{Master Alaric} about the ancient curse.

achievements.description: Met lady Beatrice. Technically, you resisted her charms. But in your imagination...
achievements.summary: Meet Lady Beatrice inside your Sweet Home.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Master Alaric} about his secret.
Sleep until you wake up. @npc{Lady Beatrice} appears in your @loc{Sweet Home}.

achievements.description: Brought corpse blood to the vampire. Not very tasty, but better than many popular diets!
achievements.summary: Give Master Alaric Blood for the first time.

steps.text: Get @item{Blood} from a corpse and give it to @npc{Master Alaric}.

achievements.description: Told Horadric the vampire was no more. Oh, if only everyone were so trusting!
achievements.summary: Tell Horadric that the vampire is gone.

steps.text: Continue the Game Of Crone questline until you can tell @npc{Horadric} the vampire is gone.

achievements.description: Watched a scene from the past. Nothing is clear but it's quite intriguing...
achievements.summary: Watch the scene from the past during the To stop an Ancient Curse questline.

steps.text: Continue the To stop an Ancient Curse questline until the scene from the past plays.

achievements.description: Brought some smelly and useless filth into Dungeon, giving all the local ghosts a laugh.
achievements.summary: Take filth into the Dungeon during the Game Of Crone questline.

steps.text: Continue the Game Of Crone questline and bring the filth into the @loc{Dungeon}.

achievements.description: All the ambushes have been cleared out. The Terminator and Rambo would have been proud.
achievements.summary: Defeat all four Golem ambushes before building the Viewing tower.

guide.context: Building the @loc{Viewing tower} and continuing the story removes the remaining Golems, so finish them first.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Golem} that ambushes you and @npc{Marquis Teodoro Jr.}.

Find and defeat the three other Golems: one just south of the @loc{Quarry}, to the north-west of the @loc{Graveyard}; one just south of the @loc{Burned house}, to the north-east of the @loc{Graveyard}; one just south of the @loc{Camp}, to the north-east of the @loc{Village}. The last Golem you defeat unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Interrogated vampire Carl, leaving Carl greatly enlightened.
achievements.summary: Interrogate the vampire Carl during the To stop an Ancient Curse questline.

steps.text: Continue the To stop an Ancient Curse questline until you interrogate @npc{Carl}.

achievements.description: Worked on someone's memory. Time to add "Neurosurgeon" to your CV.
achievements.summary: Work on a character's memory during the Game Of Crone questline.

steps.text: Continue the Game Of Crone questline until you work on someone's memory.

achievements.description: Lady Beatrice made you an offer you can't refuse. Unless you decide to refuse.
achievements.summary: Choose one of the three endings in the dialogue with Lady Beatrice.

guide.context: Each choice leads to a different ending. To see more than one, make a save copy ahead of the @loc{Viewing tower}.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Lady Beatrice} when she makes her offer.
Pick any option. The achievement unlocks during this dialogue.

achievements.description: You rescued the refugees. Welcome to the Inquisition's blacklist!
achievements.summary: Finish the Right Choice or the Dark Side ending of the Game Of Crone story.

guide.context: The Sad Ending does not unlock this. Choose either ending below, and keep a save copy from before the @loc{Viewing tower} so you can retry.

steps.text: Right Choice: say no to @npc{Lady Beatrice}. Talk to @npc{Koukol} and pick the last dialogue option. Pay him 3. Follow the story, then speak with @npc{Marquis Teodoro Jr.}.
Dark Side instead: say yes to @npc{Lady Beatrice}. Make the @item{Emulsions of Death} and carry them to the @loc{Mountain Fort}. Then speak with @npc{Marquis Teodoro Jr.}.

achievements.description: It's your last chance to join the workers and peasants. To be more specific, the donkeys and rats.
achievements.summary: Complete the first request of the Revolution questline.

steps.text: Start the Revolution questline and complete its first request.

achievements.description: You've helped the revolutionaries. Let's spread donkey communism across the world!
achievements.summary: Complete the second request of the Revolution questline.

steps.text: Continue the Revolution questline and complete the second request.

achievements.description: You've helped the revolutionaries again. They'll be hard pressed to hang you as a "dirty exploiter".
achievements.summary: Complete the third request of the Revolution questline.

steps.text: Continue the Revolution questline and complete the third request.

achievements.description: You've helped revolutionaries a third time. Who is next in line for General Secretary?
achievements.summary: Complete the fourth request of the Revolution questline.

steps.text: Continue the Revolution questline and complete the fourth request.

achievements.description: The Revolution has come to pass. It's time to look back on why you started it.
achievements.summary: Finish the Revolution questline.

steps.text: Continue the Revolution questline to its end.

achievements.description: Now you have your own camp! And hundreds of potential enemies -- in the form of Inquisitors.
achievements.summary: Complete the first major upgrade of the Refugee camp.

steps.text: Follow the Improving the Refugee camp questline and finish the first major upgrade.

achievements.description: You've improved your camp. The chances that the refugees will die of starvation got lower.
achievements.summary: Complete the second major upgrade of the Refugee camp.

steps.text: Continue the Improving the Refugee camp questline and finish the second major upgrade.

achievements.description: You've provided the camp with some fortifications. They look dubious, but the settlers like them.
achievements.summary: Complete the third major upgrade of the Refugee camp.

steps.text: Continue the Improving the Refugee camp questline and finish the third major upgrade.

achievements.description: Your camp is flawless. You should write a guide to camp management!
achievements.summary: Complete the final major upgrade of the Refugee camp.

steps.text: Continue the Improving the Refugee camp questline and finish the final major upgrade.

achievements.description: The cook has recovered her peace of mind. Now her friends won't avoid obesity and gastritis.
achievements.summary: Finish the cook's questline in the refugee camp.

steps.text: Build 2 @item{Beehives}.
Follow the cook's questline to its end.

achievements.description: You helped the undertaker deal with her dead husband's relatives. The funeral mass is soon.
achievements.summary: Finish the undertaker's questline in the refugee camp.

steps.text: Bring the undertaker 5 @item{Steel chisels}.
Follow her questline to its end.

achievements.description: You provided the tanner's son with the bright and happy future of a forest thug. Nice work!
achievements.summary: Finish the tanner's questline in the refugee camp.

steps.text: Buy a cow from @npc{Rosa}.
Buy hens from the @loc{Fresh egg basket}.
Follow the tanner's questline to its end.

achievements.description: Someone had to become the first client of the Donkey Express.
achievements.summary: Meet Euric in the cutscene triggered by an extra body from the Donkey.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Church}. When the @npc{Donkey} delivers bodies, interact with the extra @item{Body}.

achievements.displayName: A locked ghost from the past
achievements.description: How could someone not be crazy after all this time?
achievements.summary: Open the hidden Morgue room with the Old rusty key.

steps.text: Clean @npc{Gerry} with 1 @item{Mug of beer} and 1 @item{River sand} to get the @item{Old rusty key}.
Use the key on the hidden room in the @loc{Morgue}.

achievements.description: Not a 5-star suite, but it will do.
achievements.summary: Repair all five broken furniture pieces in Euric's room.

guide.context: Materials: @item{Nails} x18, @item{Flitch} x11, @item{Wooden plank} x4, @item{Wooden stick} x4, @item{Skin} x3, @item{Wooden beam} x1.

steps.text: Repair the @item{Woodbox}, @item{Table}, @item{Side rack}, @item{Old carpet} and @item{Old bed} in @loc{Euric's room}.

achievements.description: It belongs in the church.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing Euric's room.

steps.text: Repair every broken piece in @loc{Euric's room}. The achievement unlocks with the last repair.

achievements.description: Fill the Bishop.. with pride.
achievements.summary: Read the poem to the Bishop to receive a Pride charged shard.

steps.text: Write a letter to @npc{Wagner} at the @loc{Royal services box} with 1 @item{Pen and ink}. Wait one day for the reply.
Meet the @npc{Bishop} and read him the poem.

achievements.displayName: The first session of curing therapy
achievements.description: Start Euric's treatment.
achievements.summary: Return to Euric with the Pride charged shard to begin the first curing session.

steps.text: Research and build the @item{Human soul healing} upgrade in the @loc{Souls room}: @item{Nails} x4, @item{Wooden plank} x4, @item{Complex iron parts} x2. Then build the @item{Healing from pride} extension: @item{Conical flasks} x1, @item{Simple iron parts} x2.
Clean a soul with the @item{Soul healer} to get a @item{Sin shard}.
Charge it with Pride from the @npc{Bishop}, then return to @npc{Euric}.

achievements.description: Fire is so mesmerizing - even moreso when there's a boiling Inquisitor involved.
achievements.summary: Show Unusual ash to the Inquisitor to receive the Wrath charged shard.

steps.text: Meet the @npc{Inquisitor} and show him @item{Unusual ash}.

achievements.description: Share the secrets of haute cuisine with the Merchant.
achievements.summary: Give Mysterious food sauce to the Merchant to receive the Gluttony charged shard.

guide.context: Cure the @npc{Merchant} of his No Taste curse first. Without that, the dialogue option does not show.

steps.text: At the @loc{Church workbench}, make @item{Mysterious food sauce} from @item{Seed oil} x1, @item{Salt} x1 and @item{Chicken egg} x2.
Give it to the @npc{Merchant}.

achievements.displayName: The second session of curing therapy
achievements.description: Continue Euric's treatment. He says he's feeling better. Probably.
achievements.summary: Return to Euric with the Wrath and Gluttony charged shards to begin the second curing session.

steps.text: Wait a day after the first session.
Research and build the extensions for wrath and for gluttony.
Bring 2 @item{Honey} to @npc{Clotho}.
Return to @npc{Euric} with both charged shards.

achievements.description: Practice makes perfect! Even if it's the sadness of the Astrologer.
achievements.summary: Speak to the Astrologer to receive the Sloth charged shard.

steps.text: Unlock and build the @item{Healing from sloth} extension.
Speak to the @npc{Astrologer}.

achievements.description: Witness an embarrassingly hot scene.
achievements.summary: Persuade Ms Charm to dance to receive the Lust charged shard.

steps.text: Unlock and build the @item{Healing from lust} extension.
Persuade @npc{Ms Charm} to dance.

achievements.description: Even the strongest and most unswerving have their weakness.
achievements.summary: Share the rumor with Snake to receive the Envy charged shard.

steps.text: Unlock and build the @item{Healing from envy} extension.
Share the rumor with @npc{Snake}.

achievements.displayName: The third session of curing therapy
achievements.description: The treatment is over, but Euric doesn't look so cured.
achievements.summary: Return to Euric with the Sloth, Lust and Envy charged shards to finish the third curing session.

steps.text: Wait a day after the second session.
Collect the Sloth, Lust and Envy charged shards.
Return to @npc{Euric} with all three.

achievements.description: The villagers are unhappy about something. Pray it's not your fault.
achievements.summary: Sleep after asking Euric how he feels, and watch the villagers cutscene.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Euric} in his own room and ask about his health.
Go to sleep. Villagers wake you and the cutscene plays.

achievements.description: They should be satisfied. At least for now.
achievements.summary: Complete all four sets of village repairs and speak to Horadric.

guide.context: Speak to @npc{Horadric} after each set of repairs to receive the next set. Total materials: @item{Nails} x20, @item{Flitch} x13, @item{Bee} x10, @item{Wooden stick} x4, @item{Ash} x4, @item{Wooden plank} x3, @item{Piece of stone} x3, @item{Complex iron parts} x2, @item{Simple iron parts} x2, @item{Hemp rope} x2, @item{Wooden repair kit} x2, @item{Glass} x1.

steps.text: Set 1: mend the table in @loc{The Dead Horse} and the toilet door at @loc{Krezvold's}. Speak to @npc{Horadric}.
Set 2: fix the potter's wheel at @loc{Adam's}, the @loc{Egg Basket}, and the two beehives at the @loc{Beekeper's}. Speak to @npc{Horadric}.
Set 3: fix the lantern at the @loc{Farmer's} and wash the cow at @npc{Rosa}'s by giving her 4 @item{Ash}. Speak to @npc{Horadric}.
Set 4: clean up the broken glass and two barrels in front of @loc{The Dead Horse}, fix the clothesline south of the @npc{Merchant}, and clear the garbage at the southern map border.
Speak to @npc{Horadric}. The achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Nothing is keeping Smiler here any longer. Let him continue his journey - to a new beginning.
achievements.summary: Finish the last step of the Better Save Soul questline.

steps.text: Continue the Better Save Soul questline after helping the villagers until it ends.
